_note: Source-hunt on the three ANOMALOUS-MAGNITUDE gauge credits filed descriptively by the 2026-08-16 anis-star (Anis: Star) solo #2 run (docs/probe-data/anis-star-solo2-gauge.json, perPullTable W2p8 +15.3, W4p2 +16.0, W4p3 +15.2 — 'no hypothesis family predicts' them). MEASUREMENT ONLY, verdict-free. This does NOT re-open Question A, does not re-issue its INCONCLUSIVE-LOG disposition, and enacts nothing. It supplies what the 2026-08-16 run said was missing: a hypothesis that PREDICTS the anomalies, stated so a future gated run can pre-register it.
instrument: scripts/probe/read-total-damage.ts (committed local-VLM cumulative-damage reader) at --fps 5 over --at 72 --dur 8; 40/40 totals and 40/40 timers read, zero warnings. The hand-read frame crops that first surfaced this agree with the reader digit-for-digit.
fightTimeAnchor: The reader's own timer column pins it: videoT 73.00 reads timerSec 107 remaining = 73s elapsed, so fight-elapsed = videoT + 0..1s (1s timer granularity). The 03:00 -> 02:59 flip sits at videoT ~0.
theQuestionThisAnswers: Do the anomalous pulls differ from the steady ones in anything the DAMAGE number can see — extra hits, a different charge level, a different crit/core state? If yes, the gauge excess is downstream of a hit-count or charge difference and needs no new mechanic. If no, the excess is gauge-specific.
whyThisComparisonIsClean: W4p2, W4p3 and W4p4 are CONSECUTIVE pulls in the SAME refill window, the same boss range band, the same magazine, ~1.0s apart, on the same unit in the same fight. Every confound that varies across windows or bands is held fixed by construction.

damageIncrementsPerPull.note: gauge credit hidden inside the 76.51-77.21 flash span; implied plateau-to-plateau +10.8

finding.headline: The two ANOMALOUS pulls (+16.0, +15.2) and the STEADY pull that immediately follows them (+11.6) all did the IDENTICAL damage increment of 480,330. Same damage, same window, same band, consecutive pulls — different gauge credit.
whatThisRefutes: EXTRA HITS. An additional landed hit would raise the damage. It did not. The anomalous pulls are single-hit like the steady one, consistent with the perPullTable's single-ammo-decrement confirmation.

CHARGE LEVEL — the natural candidate, since data/gauge-per-shot.json carries fullChargeBonus 250 for this unit. A charge-level difference is a DAMAGE difference (shot_detail.full_charge_damage 25000). W4p2/p3/p4 share a damage value to the unit, so they share a charge level while differing in gauge by ~4pp.

CRIT/CORE state. Whatever separates damage tier A (480,330) from tier B (307,791) — ratio 1.5606 — the three compared pulls are all in tier A, so that property is held constant across the anomaly/steady boundary.
finding.whatSurvives: The excess is GAUGE-SPECIFIC: something credited burst gauge on those pulls without depositing damage. That is the signature of a skill-side gauge grant (a fillGauge-shaped credit), not of a weapon-side per-hit term.

arithmeticFit_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY.candidate: basePerTrigger 140 x 2.5 (focused-charge bonus) x 1.06 (her own +6% aura) = 371 energy = 3.71%
arithmeticFit_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY.fit: Both excesses sit within one bar column (0.72pp) of 3.71%. Equivalently: the anomalous pulls credit ONE EXTRA basePerTrigger at the focus+aura terms already in the shipped model.
arithmeticFit_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY.status: HYPOTHESIS. n=3 credits on ONE recording. It is an arithmetic coincidence with a plausible shape, NOT a measurement of a mechanism. Nothing is enacted on it.

descriptiveCoincidenceNotClaimed: All three anomalies land ~4-5s after a boss range-band transition in docs/data/range-data.md (mid->near at ~33s elapsed; near->far at ~70s elapsed; W2p8 at ~37s, W4p2/p3 at ~74-75s). Recorded because it is checkable, NOT claimed: window W3 sits entirely inside the near band and shows no anomaly at all, so band OCCUPANCY is already ruled out, and n=3 cannot separate 'transition' from coincidence.
caveats: MEASUREMENT ONLY. No engine change, no constant change, no override change, no re-issue of the 2026-08-16 Question A disposition (INCONCLUSIVE-LOG stands, as does the >=2-window counting rule's failure).
n=3 anomalous credits on ONE recording; the A3 recording shows none of them.
The damage reader is a local VLM. Its 40/40 clean read and the independent hand-read of the same crops agree, but it is one instrument on one span.
This narrows the candidate SPACE (it refutes hit-count, charge-level and crit/core explanations); it does not identify the mechanic.
Any enactment needs the /scientific-method gate with the arithmetic fit PRE-REGISTERED, not fitted after the fact as it was here.
